android.desc:
Fly over military zones protected by artificial intelligence. Dogfight will test your skills in this air battle. This plane game will offer adrenaline and an unforgettable feeling of defeating the enemy for aviation enthusiasts. After all, only the bravest and most skillful players will be able to fly through all tests and become real aviators.

Game plot:
A crazy intelligence general heads a secret international criminal organization. He is obsessed with an idea of taking over the whole world. His troops are capturing more and more territories. Settlements are being destroyed. They injure our environment with poisons and chemicals. It's time to stop this crazy dictator! You are a pilot of an air squadron. Liberate our occupied territories and destroy the dictator and his troops.

Feel beautiful spirit of aviation and desperate action battle in the sky. Military World War 2 aircraft will become your faithful companions in this fight against the enemy. Feel like real pilots and take responsibility for the outcome of this air battle. Forward to victory in the sky! War in the sky is waiting for you!

Immerse yourself in a war in which:
- Realistic action dogfight and dynamics of war
- Beautiful animation and special effects in plane crash
- Cool graphics for a mobile device
- The computer opponent is controlled by artificial intelligence (AI)
- Unique rewards for completing plane game missions
- The ability to upgrade your plane with powerful weapons to make missions easier
- Realistic air battle physics

Airplane simulators provide a unique opportunity to control aircraft, immerse yourself in the atmosphere of combat and experience the thrill of battle in the skies. This airplane game offer a wide range of options for fans of flight and military simulation games. Air battles play a crucial role in modern warfare. Get ready for an adrenaline-fueled adventure in war plane strike?

Players are offered the opportunity to feel like real pilot and squadron leader of an elite air force unit taking part in exciting air battles. Airplane games attract the attention of fans of tactical shooters and strategies. Explore the massive world of Gunship Battle.
This awesome plane game is not only an opportunity to try on the role of a military pilot, but also a testing ground for demonstrating your strategic skills. War games without the Internet, as a rule, offer a wide range of tactical solutions and strategies, which allows you to develop your ingenuity
